rec.name: Before vs. After Comparison Slider
rec.status: Built — code delivered, tested by Christoph; product image/doc entry still pending

what.text: A standalone Shopify section ("Before vs. After") with an optional section headline and subheadline above a full-width image comparison slider. Two images are stacked and a draggable vertical handle reveals one or the other. Each image has its own overlay label (small subheading plus bold title) at the bottom corner: the 'before' label sits bottom-right, the 'after' label bottom-left. Reference: the Heyskin before/after slider and the Shopify theme 'Concept'. The screenshot shows it as a headphone color-variant comparison, so the slider also works for product variants, not only before/after results.

why.text: Letting the visitor drag the handle and compare two states themselves makes the product's effect or difference tangible and builds trust in the claimed result. The interaction also increases engagement and time on page. Visual proof of a transformation reduces perceived risk. Comparing variants or colors helps with choice and supports purchase confidence.

how.text: Create the section file ed-before-vs-after.liquid and paste the delivered code. The section is styled via CSS custom properties driven by section settings. Heading and subheading blocks carry their own typography settings. The comparison component stacks a 'before' and 'after' layer; the 'after' layer is clipped with clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0) and a handle button positioned at --compare-percent (default 50%) that is moved by drag (col-resize cursor). Overlay text boxes sit in the bottom corners. The source file is truncated, so the slider JavaScript and schema were not visible and need to be checked in the full file. Add the section via the theme editor on the homepage or any template.

items: Heading block: text, color, font family, alignment (desktop/mobile), font size, line height, letter spacing, text transform, spacing, optional max width
Subheading block: text, color, font family, alignment, font size, line height, letter spacing, text transform, spacing
Bold / italic / underline for text (required in acceptance criteria)
2 images, each with its own overlay text: subheading and heading with font family, size (desktop/mobile) and color
Optional (PL team, dropped for now): influencer names/text under each image with optional blue check or custom icon

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with OS 2.0 sections and global theme settings (settings.heading_color, settings.text_color, settings.background). Uses font_picker settings for custom fonts. No app required. Reference implementation: theme 'Concept'. Slider JS and schema are not visible in the truncated source file.

images.caption: Final UI: section subheadline and gradient headline above a full-width comparison slider with draggable handle and corner labels on each image
